meta.name: Turquoise & gems
meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Thin-to-moderate, and almost entirely on TradeKey buy-leads (masked buyers, no direct contacts). The only fully verifiable, reachable foreign buyer is East Coast Carry (US) — but it wants authentic American/Navajo turquoise, a stretch for Persian Neyshabur stones. Feroza-specific leads (313 Rings CA, Zee links PK) are genuine but incidental or re-trader-grade with no reachable contact. No public lead references Persian/Iranian/Neyshabur turquoise by name. Dropped: Albatha Engineering Group and Treasure Hunt (UAE) — recycled old leads (IDs ~2.0-2.2M vs current ~3.3-3.8M on the same page), so their 'May 2026' dates are bumped display dates, plus an implausible entity-product match (an engineering conglomerate buying turquoise) and no contact; H jewelryy (Canada) — wants finished 14k/18k gold fashion jewelry (evil-eye/clover), not turquoise/loose stones; and one duplicate East Coast Carry entry (merged).
